# modules-v1: # THE source of module identity. A module is a DIRECTORY: it holds the boards
# (BUGS.md / SPRINT.md / BACKLOG.md), it is what `mod:` scopes in a claim, and it is what the gates
# attach to. Prose descriptions of this list belong in specs/work-tracking-layout.md and must not
# re-state the rows — the list lived there twice (a Layout section and a routing table) with no
# consistency check between them, which is the duplicated-state shape that has burned this repo
# repeatedly.
# Columns: module<TAB>lanes<TAB>title
#   module  repo-relative directory. MUST exist. `.` is the root: entries no single module owns.
#   lanes   comma-separated `lane:` values routed here, or `-` for the root/catch-all.
#   title   human name used in generated file headers.
# Routing an entry: by its `lane:` field, never by paths mentioned in its prose. Measured
# 2026-07-30 on 630 entries — ranking mentioned paths sends nearly everything to `tests/conformance`,
# because an entry names its GATE far more often than its cause. Authority order, strongest first:
#   1. `fixed-in:` resolving to a commit that touched sources   (fact)
#   2. `lane:` as declared by a human                            (judgement)
#   3. keyword extraction                                        (never — it produced 4 wrong owners)
# `apparatus` is split by `area:` and cannot be expressed as a lane alone; that one exception is in
# scripts/bugs-split (conformance -> tests/conformance, build -> scripts, rest -> tests).
